items.title: Pension schemes urged to ensure operational readiness as dashboard connection deadline arrives
items.summary: In-scope pension providers face a looming deadline tomorrow to connect to the pensions dashboards ecosystem.

items.title: Pensions fintech PensionPay rebrands as Corduroy and targets 2027 app launch
items.summary: Pensions start-up PensionPay has changed its name to Corduroy under new chief executive Steve Donelan and is developing a decumulation app.

items.title: Leicestershire County Council Pension Fund appoints Rekha Owen as independent person
items.summary: Professional Pensions reports on recent appointments across the pensions industry, including Leicestershire County Council Pension Fund and Standard Life.

items.title: Competitive property insurance market isn't underwater yet, says Markel Insurance CEO
items.summary: Markel Insurance CEO Simon Wilson notes that property insurance margins are narrowing amid low catastrophe activity and softer reinsurance conditions.

items.title: Ryan Specialty posts Q3 revenue growth but compensation costs climb
items.summary: Ryan Specialty reported third-quarter revenue growth of 4.7% as staff costs rose faster, reflecting a challenging market backdrop.

items.title: PHP2Shell shutdowns test cyber policy triggers
items.summary: Precautionary outages rather than confirmed breaches are driving early PHP2Shell losses, placing broker focus on policy wordings and waiting periods.
